source.head: feature/order-fraud-hold
source.title: Live (lazy, NestJS): hold high-risk orders for fraud review
source.intent:
Orders: hold high-risk orders for fraud review
Every new order is scored by the risk API. Orders at or above the risk threshold, or over 5000, are
held instead of reserving stock, and published as orders.held instead of orders.created.
New POST /orders/:id/release lets a reviewer put a held order back on the normal path.
Receipts are now only queued for succeeded payments.
